format: NDCA Sanctioned events, correction of an adjudicator's score card

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The Chairman checks marks and their transcription, refers any score card needing correction to the adjudicator concerned, and decides questions on adjudicators' marking finally.

requirement: A card needing correction is referred to the adjudicator concerned; no scorer, manager or chair replaces the adjudicator's marks; the replacement version carries the adjudicator's own authenticated confirmation bound to its exact marks.
interpretation_notes: Owner decision OD-11 (3) is stricter than IV.C.7: the Chairman may authorize the workflow but never confirm in the judge's place. Whether the Chairman's final decision on marking questions was meant to include altering a mark is not specified; DanceFlow does not read it that way. Mapping of the DanceFlow chair role to the NDCA Chairman is not approved (audit row J-01). Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-11 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
